preference: Progression set: seven mid-skill recipes, three longer Marks goals

numericPolicy.resultCount: One physical furnishing per comparator batch, including consumable-craft batches; proposed calibration.
numericPolicy.skillReq: 50, existing rare learning rung shared across ten crafts by proposed calibration.
numericPolicy.itemLevelBudget: 20, inherited from the named rare-rung band comparator; gold-sink driver only, no furnishing power.
numericPolicy.level: 15, existing non-consumable rare-rung XP level from the same band comparator; all outputs are durable decor.
numericPolicy.marks: 16, exact premium Marks pattern precedent; 48 for all three; no playtime or reset-count claim.
numericPolicy.resale: Transfer the accepted vendor-furnishing 60/250 ratio to the minimum counterfactual input value; floor copper. Requires new acceptance.

limitations: Catalog-value burden, not measured market price or player gathering time.
All-self-signed cases include unsignable staples and are conservative counterfactual floors.
Jack cases are sensitivity only; that identity is currently unreachable.
Pure learning and pricing evidence; bag-slot use, trainer action, casting, output trade and maximum-batch execution remain implementation acceptance checks.
No runtime recipe or output is registered by this probe.
